declarations.description: Progressively enhances an associated label and file input with a Light DOM drag-and-drop surface, localized status announcements, and optional image previews. Preserves authored foreground/background colors and native input focus; a currentColor dashed boundary becomes solid during a file drag.
declarations.name: FormDropzoneElement

members.name: enhanced
members.description: Whether the labeled native file input currently has dropzone enhancement.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Reload shared authored labels and update prompt/separator text in place without replacing controls, previews, selection, or focus. Returns false and logs errors for invalid configuration or an inactive instance, retaining usable text. Does not rescan markup.

members.name: isSupported
members.description: Checks the required file drag-and-drop APIs and assignable native FileList.

events.name: form-dropzone:drop
events.description: After processing a file drop and dispatching any native input/change events, before the queued status update. Includes all-rejected drops without changing the prior selection. Not emitted for picker changes, resets, text-only drops, assignment failures, or enhancement disconnected during native callbacks. Detail and file arrays are frozen; File/input objects are not frozen.

type.text: { readonly input: HTMLInputElement; readonly accepted: readonly File[]; readonly rejectedType: readonly File[]; readonly rejectedMultiple: readonly File[] }

attributes.name: drop-label
attributes.description: Drop instruction inserted before the author-provided label.

attributes.name: separator-label
attributes.description: Text inserted between the drop instruction and label.

attributes.name: received-message
attributes.description: Live-region template for accepted files. Supports {files} and {count}.

attributes.name: rejected-type-message
attributes.default: "Rejected because the file type is not accepted: {files}."
attributes.description: Live-region template for files rejected by accept. Supports {files} and {count}.

attributes.name: rejected-multiple-message
attributes.default: "Rejected because only one file is allowed: {files}."
attributes.description: Live-region template for excess files on a single-file input. Supports {files} and {count}.

attributes.name: preview-images
attributes.description: Renders accepted image selections in a Light DOM preview grid.
